name: clDice line-continuity loss
why: Jacky 31 Oct 'do what is best': a soft-skeleton clDice term (Shit et al. CVPR 2021, used for road extraction) on top of the current skeleton-recall term, so kerbs are traced as whole lines, not dashes; targets found and whole lines
